label: What the agent reads and proposes
section: What the agent reads and proposes
subgoals: Read the drop map and its causing instances
Classify the hot spot as static or dynamic
Propose a fix through the engines' interfaces

label: Choosing among candidates
subgoals: Compute the gap between drop and budget
Keep the candidates whose predicted reduction closes it
Pick the cheapest and confirm it with the accurate solver

label: Verifying and recording the ECO
subgoals: Re-run IR, EM, DRC and timing on the changed area
Log the trigger, edit, metrics and versions
Submit the verified ECO for human approval
